scripts.start:generic: npm run prep:generic && APP_FLAVOR=generic expo start -c
scripts.start:islamic: npm run prep:islamic && APP_FLAVOR=islamic expo start -c
scripts.ios:generic: npm run prep:generic && APP_FLAVOR=generic expo run:ios
scripts.ios:islamic: npm run prep:islamic && APP_FLAVOR=islamic expo run:ios
scripts.android:generic: npm run prep:generic && APP_FLAVOR=generic expo run:android
scripts.android:islamic: npm run prep:islamic && APP_FLAVOR=islamic expo run:android
scripts.web:generic: npm run prep:generic && APP_FLAVOR=generic expo start --web
scripts.web:islamic: npm run prep:islamic && APP_FLAVOR=islamic expo start --web
scripts.export:generic: npm run prep:generic && APP_FLAVOR=generic expo export --platform all --output-dir dist/generic
scripts.export:islamic: npm run prep:islamic && APP_FLAVOR=islamic expo export --platform all --output-dir dist/islamic
scripts.build:generic:ios: npm run prep:generic && eas build --profile generic --platform ios
scripts.build:generic:android: npm run prep:generic && eas build --profile generic --platform android
scripts.build:islamic:ios: npm run prep:islamic && eas build --profile islamic --platform ios
scripts.build:islamic:android: npm run prep:islamic && eas build --profile islamic --platform android
